requirements.evidence: 3 cells with bins: bin:0,0,0 full (large fabric/tools), bin:0,1,0 div2 (2 compartments for scissors/notions), bin:1,0,0 div3 (3 compartments for buttons/thread/spools). Props show tape measure, marker, tweezers (as scissors), small parts heap for buttons.

finish.summary: Compact 3-cell hexagonal organizer: large open tray + 2-compartment + 3-compartment bins for sorted sewing notions. Staged with tape measure, tools and small parts to show tidy storage. Caps and joint bolts applied.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
